question: Xi Jinping out before 2027?
description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if China's General Secretary of the Communist Party, Xi Jinping, is removed from power for any length of time between July 3, 2025, and December 31, 2026, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

CCP General Secretary Xi Jinping will be considered removed from power if he announces his resignation from his role as General Secretary, or is otherwise dismissed, detained, disqualified, or otherwise loses his position or is prevented from fulfilling his duties as General Secretary within this market's timeframe.

The primary resolution source for this market will be a consensus of credible reporting.

Extensive purges of senior Politburo and Central Military Commission figures through mid-2026 have eliminated potential rivals and reinforced loyalty networks without visible elite fragmentation or organized opposition. At 73, Xi has shown no public signals of stepping down and continues directing policy priorities ahead of the expected late-2027 Party Congress, where a fourth term remains the baseline outlook. High-volume trading reflects this stability, with no recent diplomatic, economic, or institutional developments indicating imminent leadership change. Low-probability shifts could still arise from an acute health event, an unanticipated elite backlash, or a major external crisis that alters internal calculations before year-end.
